stage1.impression: A competent but empty CG shop at night. The floor is the brightest surface in the frame, the shopfront behind the Tropos pair is a flat black void with a floating grey rectangle in it, and the red speakers are underlit against it. Shelving, table and lamps are tidy and catalogue-like, with no sign of life, no pools of light and no texture at 1:1 (the floor reads as grey laminate planks, not sealed concrete). A magazine would read this as a generic shop showroom render, not a specific place.

blocking_9: The floor must stop being the brightest large surface: floor [0,540,1200,800] lum_median at or below 45, with light falling in pools under the spots rather than a uniform wash rising toward the camera
The Tropos pair must be the hero: speaker region [495,335,705,510] lum_median 45 or more, with light visibly passing through the Ember acrylic and its edges reading
The shopfront must read as a window onto a night street (lit windows opposite, a street lamp, pavement), not a black mirror with a floating grey rectangle
The floor must read as sealed concrete at 1:1 (trowel marks, sheen variation, no plank seams)
Signs of life and specificity: records out of sleeves, glasses, price cards legible, a coat, so the room reads as this pop-up rather than a generic showroom
Atmosphere and depth: the dark band of ceiling and window needs held shadow detail, not empty black

defects.what: Floor is the brightest large area (lum_median 108, brightening toward the camera to 123); reads as grey timber planks with a repeating seam pattern, not sealed concrete
Floating grey rectangles in the window glass (a reflection of a ceiling element or a backdrop plane) that read as a CG artefact
Shopfront and back zone are an empty black void (lum_median 11.6); no street, no building opposite (0 windows lit), only a few stray point highlights
Tropos pair underlit (lum_median 23.7, below the 45 target); acrylic reads as flat salmon-pink panels rather than tinted cast acrylic with glowing edges
Window spots throw a hard, blotchy pink-white pool onto the floor in front of the plinth that looks like a decal
Table top is flat, evenly lit pale oak with clipped highlights (clip 0.2 %); the Mantle and props look staged, no glasses or sign of use
Left shelving: uniform glowing shelf edges from LED strips read as a retail fixture; shelves mostly empty, Cores lined up like a catalogue
Upper left wall plaster brighter (median 89) than the products, smooth and textureless
Right wall plaster bright (median 78) and featureless; right shelving cropped hard at the edge

changes.problem: The floor dominates the frame as its brightest, most uniform surface and reads as laminate, not concrete.

evidence.measured: lum_median 108.2, lum_p95 160, falloff along y rising 92 to 123 toward the camera

change.setting: materials: the floor (sealed concrete scan tint) and its sheen
change.to: tint #2F2C29, a seamless trowelled concrete scan with low, uneven sheen (roughness 0.35 to 0.6 varied)

changes.expected: Floor drops into the low key and the pools under the spots read against it; no plank seams.

changes.problem: The Tropos pair, meant as the hero, sits darker than the floor and the walls.

change.to: 2 x 90 W, 2600 K, cone 20 deg, aimed at the upper cabinet and horn, plus a low back-light behind each cabinet so light passes through the acrylic

changes.expected: The Ember acrylic glows and its edges catch light; the pair reads at a glance.

changes.problem: The shopfront is a black void; nothing says this is a storefront at night onto a street.

change.setting: outside: the building opposite's lit windows, and the street lamp
change.to: 0.3 lit (warm, varied); street lamp 0.4 W/m2 at 2200 K

changes.expected: A soft, out-of-focus street behind the speakers that silhouettes them and gives depth.

changes.problem: Floating grey rectangles in the window glass read as a CG artefact.

evidence.measured: two flat grey planes, lum_median 21.5 against the void around them

change.setting: plain description: the reflected ceiling element or backdrop plane
change.from: visible as a flat grey slab in the glass
change.to: removed, or replaced by a real fascia/transom with a lit sign-free frame and mullions so the glass has structure

changes.expected: No unexplained shapes in the window; the glass reads by its frame and soft reflections of the pendants.

changes.problem: Light is an even wash rather than pools; walls and floor outshine the products.

change.setting: track spots: the right and left walls' shelves; the room's fill
change.from: 40 W and 32 W at cone 34 deg; fill 0.12 W/m2
change.to: 18 W and 15 W at cone 22 deg aimed onto shelf contents, not the wall above; fill 0.06 W/m2

changes.expected: Pools on the shelves with dark between; plaster above shelves falls to the low key.

changes.problem: The shelf LED strips make every shelf edge glow uniformly, which reads as a retail fixture.

evidence.measured: bright continuous lines on every shelf front at 1:1

changes.expected: Shelves read as steel and oak lit by the spots, with the Cores providing the colour.

changes.problem: No sign of life; the room reads as a generic, unopened showroom.

evidence.measured: table holds only the products and a pen; shelves sparse

change.to: a record out of its sleeve on the Mantle, two glasses on the table, legible price cards, more records filed face-out, a coat over a chair at the bar end

changes.expected: The frame reads as a specific, used pop-up a magazine would run.

changes.problem: The table top is evenly bright with clipped highlights rather than a pool.

change.setting: track spots: the table; materials: the oak's stain
change.to: 6 W cone 20 deg centred on the Mantle; oak stained one step darker

changes.expected: A pool on the table falling off to its ends; no clipping.

out_of_scope.request: Saturated colours from Cores and Hemispheres compete with the Ember pair
out_of_scope.why: The card fixes the products in their tints as placed; only their light levels may change

out_of_scope.request: Make the Tropos acrylic look thicker or clearer
out_of_scope.why: The speaker's shape, colour and parts are fixed
